sonicrec.title: Fly by Sound: recording
sonicrec.status.asking: Waiting for the pilot to agree: press T again, or use Start recording.
sonicrec.status.starting: Starting. If the browser asks for the microphone, choose Allow.
sonicrec.status.closing: Stopping. A survey may be running.
sonicrec.status.finishing: Finishing the recording on this device.
sonicrec.voice.denied: Voice: the microphone was not allowed, so only the flight is recorded.
sonicrec.voice.unavailable: Voice: there is no microphone, or this browser cannot record it, so only the flight is recorded.
sonicrec.voice.failed: Voice: the recording of the voice stopped.
sonicrec.consent.title: Before recording
sonicrec.consent.text: The flight and, if the browser allows the microphone, the pilot's voice are recorded on this device only. Nothing is sent to anyone until the pilot agrees to send it, in a separate step.
sonicrec.consent.agree: The pilot agrees to this recording.
sonicrec.pilot.title: The pilot
sonicrec.pilot.guardian: A parent or guardian has signed the consent form, and I confirm it
sonicrec.pilot.guardian.help: Without this the recording stays on this device and cannot be sent.
sonicrec.sessions.title: Recordings on this device
sonicrec.state.unfinished: Not finished: the page was closed or crashed during it.
sonicrec.msg.kept: Kept. It is a recording that ended early; it can be saved to disk or sent.
sonicrec.msg.recorded: The recording is saved on this device. Save it to disk too.
sonicrec.note.persist: The browser may clear this storage when the disk is nearly full. Save recordings to disk.
sonicrec.note.memory: This browser cannot keep recordings safe: a closed tab loses them. Save each recording to disk right after it ends.
sonicrec.survey.title: Fly by Sound: a few questions
sonicrec.survey.listening: Listening: say your answer out loud, then press {key}.
